description: This file contains utility functions for handling URL redirection, including extracting and normalizing redirect parameters, generating prefixed paths, and verifying URL paths, primarily used in authentication flows within a web application.

methods.name: getReturnTo
methods.description: Verifies encrypted URL parameters using JWT and returns normalized redirect parameters, defaulting to a learn page if verification fails.

methods.name: normalizeParams
methods.description: Ensures redirect parameters are valid, defaulting to the home location and learn page if invalid or outside allowed origins.

methods.name: getPrefixedLandingPath
methods.description: Constructs a URL path with an optional language prefix.

methods.name: getParamsFromUrl
methods.description: Parses a URL to extract origin, path prefix, and return URL, then normalizes these parameters.

methods.name: getRedirectParams
methods.description: Extracts redirect parameters from the referer header in an HTTP request.

methods.name: getLoginRedirectParams
methods.description: Extracts redirect parameters from a signed cookie after login, then normalizes them.

methods.name: haveSamePath
methods.description: Checks if two URLs share the same pathname.
